bludgeon.description: Choose one enemy model as a bludgeon, and another model as the target. Both suffer a S8 hit. If the target is slain, you may keep repeating this until the bludgeon is not slain (in which case that model is knocked Prone). The bludgeon cannot be a Monster, Chariot or War Beast. If the bludgeon is a Cavalry model, then the rider is picked up and separated from their mount.
bludgeon.name: Bludgeon

guthwine.description: If Eomer rolls a natural 6 To Wound, he may make an additional To Wound roll against the same target. If the additional roll is a natural 6, it does not benefit from this special rule.
guthwine.name: Guthwine

the-price-of-grief.description: If Theoden or Eowyn are in the same army, and either are slain, Eomer must re-rolls all failed To Wound rolls for the rest of the game, and he must charge if able to do so.
the-price-of-grief.name: The Price of Grief

legendary-hero.description: The first time each turn Eorl spends a Might Point, roll a D6. On a 4+, the Might Point is free and does not reduce Eorl's store of Might.
legendary-hero.name: Legendary Hero

spear-mastery.description: This model may use its throwing spears as a normal spear during the Fight Phase, so long as it hasn't made a shooting attack with it in either the preceding Move Phase or Shoot Phase.
spear-mastery.name: Spear Mastery

i-shall-kill-you-if-you-touch-him.description: Whilst within 3\" of Theoden, Eowyn may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1. If Theoden is slain, she becomes Fearless, and re-rolls any failed To Wound rolls when striking the model who slew Theoden.
i-shall-kill-you-if-you-touch-him.name: I Shall Kill You if You Touch Him

merry.description: If taken as an option, Merry becomes a passenger on Eowyn's horse. He will have a shield, be an Independent Hero, and still count towards the army's total models and Break Point. He does not take up a space in Eowyn's warband. Whilst he remains mounted, Eowyn gains Resistant to Magic, Attack 3, and can spend Merry's Might, Will and Fate.
merry.name: Merry

noldorin-daggers.description: These are Elven hand weapons, which Erestor may also use as Elven throwing weapons. Erestor may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes or when making Shooting Attacks with these weapons.
noldorin-daggers.name: Noldorin Daggers

horn-of-the-hammerhand.description: This is a Unique war horn. Additionally, once per game at the start of any Move Phase, Erkenbrand can unleash a fearsome blow of the Horn of the Hammerhand. Until the End Phase of the turn, enemy models within 24\" of Erkenbrand suffer a -1 penalty to any Courage Test they are required to make.
horn-of-the-hammerhand.name: Horn of the Hammerhand

exchange-armour-and-bow-for-heavy-armour.name: Exchange armour and bow for heavy armour

a-chance-for-faramir-captain-of-gondor-t.description: If Faramir's army is Broken, he may re-roll any failed To Wound rolls when making strikes, and declare a free Heroic Resolve each turn.
a-chance-for-faramir-captain-of-gondor-t.name: A Chance for Faramir, Captain of Gondor to show his Quality

wizards-pupil.description: If Faramir is alive and you choose to give Priority to your opponent, then Faramir and friendly Warrior models within 3\" of him gain Dominant (2) until the end of the turn.
wizards-pupil.name: Wizard's Pupil

get-out-of-my-fields.description: Whilst within range of an Objective Marker, Farmer Maggot does not suffer the -1 penalty to his Duel rolls for using a two-handed weapon.
get-out-of-my-fields.name: Get out of my fields!

pitchfork.description: A Pitchfork can either be used as a spear or a two-handed weapon.
pitchfork.name: Pitchfork

this-is-our-country.description: Friendly Hobbit models within 3\" of Farmer Cotton may re-roll any rolls of a 1 when making a Duel Roll.
this-is-our-country.name: This is our Country

oblivious-to-pain.description: Whenever a Feral Uruk-hai suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On the roll of a natural 6, the Wound is ignored.
oblivious-to-pain.name: Oblivious to Pain

fili-the-dwarf-champion-of-erebor.name: Fili the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

combat-synergy.description: At the start of any phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, if Kili and Fili are within 1\" of each other, then they can swap places and not have it count as Moving. If they do this, then during the Fight phase of that turn they may re-roll a single D6 in the Duel roll.
combat-synergy.name: Combat Synergy

hunt-master.description: Whilst he has the Cavalry keyword, Fimbul does not suffer any penalties for Moving through Difficult Terrain, and therefore may still gain bonuses for Charging. Also, whilst he has the Cavalry keyword, Fimbul gains +1 to his Fight value on a turn in which he Charges.
hunt-master.name: Hunt Master

loremaster.description: At any point during his Activation, Floi can spend a Will Point to choose a single enemy model within 12\" and Line of Sight of himself. If he does, then for the remainder of the turn friendly models within 6\" of Floi gain a bonus of +1 To Wound against the chosen model both when making Strikes and when making Shooting Attacks.
loremaster.name: Loremaster

the-living-lore.description: Whenever a friendly model slays an enemy Hero or Monster model that Floi can draw Line of Sight to, Floi may regain a Will Point spent earlier in the battle.
the-living-lore.name: The Living Lore

foe-spear.description: A spear, if this model is Supporting a model with an Iron Shield, they gain +1 To Wound when making Strikes against Monster models.

a-helpful-sort.description: If Folco is within 3\" of Frodo, then Frodo can spend Folco's Will Points to declare a Heroic Move instead of using one of his own Might Points.

high-spirits.description: Whenever a friendly Hobbit model within 6\" of Folco spends a Might Point, they may roll a D6. On a natural 6, the Might Point spent is free and does not reduce the model's store of Might.

lord-of-lossarnach.description: Friendly Lossarnach models within 3\" may re-roll results of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

the-horn-of-lossarnach.description: A war horn. Once per game at the beginning of his Activation, Forlong may use it to give friendly models within 12\" of him the Terror special rule until the end of the turn.
the-horn-of-lossarnach.name: The Horn of Lossarnach

incantations-of-power.description:
After rolling for Priority, Fraecht can spend a point of Will to have one of the following incantations take effect for the rest of the turn.
Strength - Friendly Carn Dum models within 6" of Fraecht must re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.
Endurance - Whenever a Friendly Carn Dum model within 6" of Fraecht suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On a 5+, that Wound is ignored.
Swiftness - Friendly Carn Dum models that start their move within 6" of Fraecht are not slowed by difficult terrain (except for water features).
incantations-of-power.name: Incantations of Power

lord-of-harrowdale.description: Any Warriors of Rohan in Frealaf's warband are upgraded to Warriors of Harrowdale. If they have Line of Sight to Frealaf, these warriors may re-roll failed Intelligence tests and gain Shieldwall.
lord-of-harrowdale.name: Lord of Harrowdale

mutual-respect.description: Whilst within 6\" of Hera, Frealaf gains the Master of Battle (4+) special rule.
mutual-respect.name: Mutual Respect

claim-the-throne.description: If the enemy General is removed as a casualty whilst within 6\" of Freca, then for the duration of the battle, friendly Dunland models treat Freca as a banner with range 6\".

dunlending-heritage.description: Friendly Dunland Warrior models within 6\" of Freca gain a bonus of +1 to their Fight value.

live-to-fight-another-day.description: If Fredegar attempts to Charge an enemy model with the Terror special rule and fails the Courage Test, then Fredegar may still Move as normal; however, he may not Charge any model that turn.

go-for-the-horse.description: Friendly Dunland models within 3\" of Frida may re-roll failed To Wound rolls when making Strikes against an enemy Mount.
go-for-the-horse.name: Go for the Horse!

readied-stance.description: Cavalry models do not gain the Extra Attack and Knock to the Ground bonuses whilst Engaged in Combat with Frida, or Engaged in Combat with a model Frida is Supporting.

mithril-coat.description: A piece of Mithril armour, additionally Frodo may re-roll Fate rolls of a 1.

go-back-to-the-void-from-whence-you-came.description: Galadriel may target any enemy with Banishment as if it were a Spirit model, though non-Spirit models targeted will gain an extra free Will point to their Resist test. Once per game instead of casting a Magical Power, as long as she has at least 1 Will point, she may choose an enemy within 6\", who immediately suffers D3 Wounds. After doing this, her Will points becomes 0, she is placed Prone, and no longer benefits from her The Lady of Lorien or War Aspect special rules (and thus becomes Unarmed).
go-back-to-the-void-from-whence-you-came.name: Go back to the void, from whence you came!

the-light-of-earendil.description: At any point during her Activation, Galadriel can roll a D6. On a 3+, she counts as having cast the Blinding Light Magical Power. This does not prevent her from casting another Magical Power during her Activation.
the-light-of-earendil.name: The Light of Earendil

war-aspect.description: Enemies within 6\" of Galadriel suffer a -1 penalty to any Courage tests. Additionally, Galadriel never counts as Unarmed.

dunlending-commander.description: Whilst alive on the battlefield, if you win the Priority roll and give Priority to your opponent, then friendly Dunlending Warrior models within 6\" of General Targg may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes, until the end of the turn.

i-myself-am-sitting-pretty-on-43.description: If Gimli has fewer kills than Legolas, he gets +1 bonus on To Wound rolls when making Strikes.
i-myself-am-sitting-pretty-on-43.name: I myself am sitting pretty on 43

lord-of-dale.description: Girion's Stand Fast is 12\", and friendly Dale models within 3\" of him may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.
lord-of-dale.name: Lord of Dale

windlance-trained.description: If Girion takes a Windlance, he will be the only crew, but can move more than 6\" away, and rotate it without any penalty. Windlance attacks against Monster models gain a +1 bonus to any rolls on the Scatter Table.

hero-of-the-elves.description: Glorfindel gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes against Monster models.

mercenary-ambush.description: Warbands lead by a Goblin Mercenary Captain that contain solely Goblin Mercenaries do not have to deploy at the start of the game, as they may be kept in reserve. If you choose to do so, then from turn 2 onwards, the Captain must take an Intelligence test at the end of each of the controlling player's Activation phases. If passed, the player decides whether the warband arrives. If failed, the opposing player decides. If they arrive, they should be fully placed within a terrain piece that the entire warband can hide within or behind. They cannot be placed in enemy Control Zones, cannot Move that turn, but may otherwise act normally. If the Mercenaries cannot be placed as described above, then they may arrive from any board edge via the rules for Reinforcements.
mercenary-ambush.name: Mercenary Ambush

chittering-hordes.description: This model can support other models who also have the Chittering Hordes rule, as if they had a spear. Supporting models cannot use a two-handed weapon in the same Combat.

chittering-hordes.name: Chittering Hordes

goldberry-is-waiting.description: Goldberry may only be included in your Army if it includes Tom Bombadil. Goldberry must give up a Will Point during the End Phase of any turn in which she was Engaged in Combat. Should Goldberry be reduced to 0 Will Points, or if there are no friendly models on the board other than herself and/or Tom Bombadil, then she will simply wander off back to her homestead. Remove Goldberry as a casualty.
goldberry-is-waiting.name: Goldberry is waiting

river-daughter.description: Goldberry treats all kinds of terrain as Open Ground and always treats the result of any Climb, Leap, Jump and Swim Tests as a 6. Goldberry cannot be targeted by any abilities, special rules, Magical Powers, Brutal Power Attacks or shooting attacks, either friendly or enemy. This means that any Magical Powers that would target Goldberry will automatically be resisted, even if they would target multiple models. If Goldberry is hit by a missile weapon as a result of a failed In The Way Test, the shot will automatically disappear and have no effect. Goldberry does not have a Control Zone. Enemy models cannot Move into base contact with Goldberry for any reason, unless Goldberry's controlling player explicitly allows it. If a model would be forced into base contact with Goldberry, then they will stop just before moving into base contact. Goldberry may Charge enemy models as normal, and her side will automatically win any Combat that Goldberry is involved in; however, when they do, friendly models may not make Strikes in that Combat. Goldberry may never carry Objectives under any circumstances and may never be chosen in Scenarios that require a player to choose a specific Hero model.
river-daughter.name: River-daughter

sing-a-jolly-song-goldberry.description:
At any point during her Activation, Goldberry may spend a Will Point to sing one of the songs listed below to gain the relevant effect. Goldberry may sing any number of these songs during her Activation, and may sing each of these songs as many times as she wishes during her Activation unless otherwise stated. Every time Goldberry sings a song it will cost her a Will Point.
"Supper is Ready" - Choose a friendly model within 6" of Goldberry. The chosen model immediately regains a single Wound lost earlier in the battle. A model may only be chosen by this song once per turn.
"Have Peace Now" - Choose an enemy model within 6" of Goldberry. The chosen model may not be Activated during their player's Activation Phase this turn, but may otherwise act normally in all other Phases. This song may only be sung once per turn.
"Heed no Nightly Noises" - Choose a friendly model within 6" of Goldberry. Until the end of the turn, the chosen model automatically passes any Courage Tests it is required to take. Additionally, if the chosen model Charges an enemy model, the chosen model will increase their Fight Value by 1 until the End Phase of the turn. A model may only be chosen by this song once per turn.
sing-a-jolly-song-goldberry.name: Sing a Jolly Song (Goldberry)

impressive-girth.description: Whenever Golfimbul suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On the roll of a 5+, the Wound is ignored. Golfimbul may use Might to influence this roll, though he may not use this special rule against Wounds caused by Magical Powers.
impressive-girth.name: Impressive Girth

additional-text.text-1: Gollum has strong, strangling fingers and so is never considered to be Unarmed - ever! If your opponent does not have a Ringbearer in their Army, then Gollum carries the One Ring.

the-precious.description: If your opponent's Army contains a Ringbearer, then when Gollum Moves, he must always Charge the enemy Ringbearer if possible. Additionally, if Gollum kills the enemy Ringbearer in Combat, then he will automatically regain the One Ring - from that point onwards he counts as having it as part of his Wargear.
the-precious.name: The Precious

additional-text.text-1: Crewed by three Minas Tirith Siege Crew, one of which is the Siege Veteran.

rapid-fire.description: A Bolt Thrower doesn't shoot like a normal Siege Engine. Instead, it may make D6 shoot attacks in the same way as a normal Missile Weapon. No Scatter is required for these shots, they will either hit or miss. Each shot may be fully resolved before determining the target of the next one. Shots fired by the Bolt Thrower do not kill their targets outright if they Wound them.
rapid-fire.name: Rapid Fire

swift-reload.description: AWhen firing the Bolt Thrower, you may roll two dice and pick the highest result when determining how many shots it may take.
swift-reload.name: Swift Reload

area-effect.description: After rolling To Hit against a Battlefield Target, all other models within 2\" of them suffer a Strength 5 and will be knocked Prone.
area-effect.name: Area Effect

wall-breaker.description: When rolling To Wound against a Siege Target, make two To Wound rolls and pick the highest. Also, a successful To Wound roll against a Siege Target will do D3 Wounds rather than 1.
wall-breaker.name: Wall-breaker

adaptive-fighter.description: If Gorbah wins a Duel Roll, he may choose an enemy model involved in the Combat, and that model must back away in a direction chosen by Gorbag. For example, they may be forced to back away over the edge of cliff, and take fall damage. Other models then back away as normal and Strikes are resolved.
adaptive-fighter.name: Adaptive Fighter

orcish-brawler.description: If outnumbered in a Combat, Gorbag gains +1 to his Attack value for the duration of the Combat.
orcish-brawler.name: Orcish Brawler

come-here-maggot.description: Whenever Goroth suffers a Wound, before any Fate Rolls are made, he may roll a D6. On a 2+, he may choose a single friendly Mordor Orc model within 1\" to immediately suffer the Wound instead of him. Fate Rolls can then be made as normal.
come-here-maggot.name: Come here maggot!

ironskin.description: If at the start of the Fight Phase Gorulf is Engaged in Combat with an enemy Hero model, he may declare a Heroic Defence for free.
ironskin.name: Ironskin

the-age-of-men-is-over.description: Friendly Mordor Orc models within 3\" gain the Hatred (Man) special rule.
the-age-of-men-is-over.name: The Age of Men is Over

the-time-of-the-orc-has-come.description: Once per game, at the start of any Fight phase, all friendly Mordor Orc models within 12\" may re-roll failed To Wound rolls when making Strikes.
the-time-of-the-orc-has-come.name: The time of the Orc has come

gothmogs-right-hand.description: If Gothmog's Enforcer is within 3\" of Gothmog, then Gothmog may spend one of Gothmog's Enforcer's Will points to declare a Heroic Move or Heroic March, instead of spending his own Might points. Additionally, when Gothmog declares a Heroic March or Heroic Move within 3\" of Gothmog's Enforcer, Gothmog can measure the range of the With Me or At the Double from Gothmog's Enforcer, rather than himself.
gothmogs-right-hand.name: Gothmog's Right Hand

trample.description: When a Great Beast Tramples, it will inflict 3 Strength 6 hits.
trample.name: Trample

additional-text.text-1: If Radagast dismounts from the Great Eagle, it will automatically pass its Courage test for being a Separated Mount.

majestic-steed.description: In a turn in which Thranduil Charges into Combat, he resolves his Strikes at Strength 5. Additionally, each time this model Charges into Combat, it will inflict a single Strength 4 hit upon one model it has Charged (Cavalry models suffer this hit on both the rider and the Mount). If after this hit Thranduil is no longer Engaged in Combat, he may continue his Move in any way his controlling player wishes; stopping straight away, Charging another enemy model, or anything in between.
majestic-steed.name: Majestic Steed

mattock.description: Two-handed weapon, where if this model wins a Duel roll, they may choose to try and knock down an enemy instead of making Strikes. Choose a single enemy in the combat, and both models roll a D6, adding their Strength values. If this model has an equal or higher result, then the chosen enemy is knocked Prone. This may be done before any other friendly models make their Strikes.
mattock.name: Mattock

This may be done before any other friendly models make their Strikes.
mattock.name: Mattock

a-traitor-within.description:
Grima can be deployed in one of two ways, though his controlling player must decide which before either Army is deployed. Grima can either be deployed as part of Saruman's Warband (in which case he will not take up a space in the Warband), or as part of the enemy Army.

If Grima chooses to be deployed as part of the enemy Army, he must select an enemy Hero. Once that Hero and their Warband has been deployed, Grima's controlling player can deploy Grima as if he was also part of that Warband, following all the usual deployment rules. Grima is still part of his controlling player's Army, and will Activate like any other model in his controlling player's Army.

If Grima is deployed as part of the enemy Army, then enemy models treat him as a friendly model, and therefore cannot shoot him, Charge him, make Strikes against him, target him with special rules, or make a shooting attack in which Grima would be In The Way. They may also ignore his Control Zone. They can, however, target him with Magical Powers like any other enemy model.

Whilst Grima is considered a friendly model, Grima may ignore the Control Zones of enemy models and may Move through enemy models as if they weren't there. When Grima Moves this way, he cannot end his Move overlapping or in base contact with an enemy model. Grima can choose to Charge an enemy model as normal if he wishes.

These restrictions immediately end if Saruman is slain, if Grima Charges an enemy model, if Grima destroys an enemy Siege Engine, or if Grima interacts with an Objective Marker (such as destroying a Supply Marker or picking up an objective), at which point Grima is treated as a normal enemy model and can be Charged, shot at and slain like any other model.
a-traitor-within.name: A Traitor Within

wormtongue.description: Heroic actions cast by enemy heroes within 6\" cost 2 Might points, rather than 1.
wormtongue.name: Wormtongue

crushing-strength.description: If Grimbeorn wins a Duel Roll he can choose to use this Brutal Power Attack. If he does, choose a single enemy model involved in the Combat. The chosen model immediately suffers a Strength 10 hit. If the To Wound Roll is successful (even if the Wound is prevented), the model immediately suffers another Strength 10 hit, and so on until either Grimbeorn fails a To Wound Roll, or the chosen model is slain and removed as a casualty.
crushing-strength.name: Crushing Strength

leader-of-the-beornings.description: Only Beorning models can benefit from Grimbeorn's Heroic Actions or Stand Fast.
leader-of-the-beornings.name: Leader of the Beornings

skin-changer.description: At the beginning of his Activation, Grimbeorn the Bear can change his form from Bear to Man. If he does, place the Man model in base contact with the Bear model, and then remove the Bear model from play. If there is no space to place the Man model, then Grimbeorn cannot transform. Once he has transformed, Grimbeorn may continue his Activation as normal, including Charging in which case check the Line of Sight from the newly placed Man model to determine whether Grimbeorn can Charge. Once Grimbeorn has transformed, he uses the Grimbeorn profile - though his Wounds, Might, Will and Fate Points remain the same between both profiles.
skin-changer.name: Skin-changer

leader-of-the-beornings.description: Only Beorning models can benefit from Grimbeorn's Heroic Actions or Stand Fast.
leader-of-the-beornings.name: Leader of the Beornings

skin-changer.name: Skin-changer

chittering-hordes.description: This model may Support as if it had a spear, with the exception that they can only Support another model with this special rule. A model Supporting whilst using this special rule cannot also use a two-handed weapon in the same Combat.
chittering-hordes.name: Chittering Hordes

swap-with-me.description: At the start of the Fight Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions Step, Grinnah can choose a friendly Goblin model on a 25mm base within 3\" and swap places with it. This does not count as Moving.
swap-with-me.name: Swap with Me

loyal-hounds.description: Grip, Fang and Wolf will always use Farmer Maggot's Courage value whilst he is alive on the battlefield. Additionally, they treat Farmer Maggot as a banner with range 6\", and may re-roll failed To Wound rolls whilst within 6\" of him.
loyal-hounds.name: Loyal Hounds

lets-put-a-maggot-hole-in-your-belly.description: If Grishnakh wins a Duel roll, and there are no other allies involved in the combat (including Supporting models), then he can choose a single 25mm enemy model he was Engaged in Combat with and roll a D6. On a 4+, that model is knocked Prone before Strikes are made.
lets-put-a-maggot-hole-in-your-belly.name: Let's put a maggot hole in your belly

mithril-crown.description: This is a Unique piece of wargear. Friendly Moria Goblin models within 3\" of Groblog gain the Dominant (2) special rule.
mithril-crown.name: Mithril Crown

protectors-of-the-white-tree.description: If within 6\" of a friendly Gondor General, this model gains Dominant (2).
protectors-of-the-white-tree.name: Protectors of the White Tree

exchange-elven-pike-for-banner-and-elven.name: Exchange Elven pike for banner and Elven hand weapon

caras-galadhon-fighting-style.description: This model may use the Shielding rule with their Elven pike. The usual restrictions for Shielding still apply, chiefly that a model using the Shielding rule cannot be Supported by another model, not even by another Guard of the Galadhrim Court.
caras-galadhon-fighting-style.name: Caras Galadhon Fighting Style

immortal-hunger.description: Each time Gulavhar slays a model in Combat, it regains a single Wound lost earlier in the battle. These Wounds are regained at the end of the Combat. Gulavhar can only regain Wounds in this way by making Strikes, never by using a Brutal Power Attack.
immortal-hunger.name: Immortal Hunger

strength-of-body-strength-of-will.description: Gulavhar's Attacks are always equal to its remaining Wounds. Additionally, for each Wound Gulavhar has lost, worsen Gulavhar's Courage value by 1 (this will improve again should Gulavhar regain a lost Wound via the Immortal Hunger special rule below).
strength-of-body-strength-of-will.name: Strength of Body, Strength of Will

oblivious-to-pain.description: Whenever this model suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On the roll of a natural 6, the Wound is ignored.
oblivious-to-pain.name: Oblivious to Pain

area-effect.description: After rolling To Hit against a Battlefield Target, all other models within 2\" of them suffer a Strength 5 and will be knocked Prone.
area-effect.name: Area Effect

catapult.description: A Siege Engine with range 12\" - 96\" and Strength 10. May still fire in same turn the troll has Moved, but will only hit on the roll of a natural 6. May still fire while Engaged in Combat, but on a To Hit roll of a natural 1, the troll suffers a Wound. Does not have a normal siege crew, and can always be fired if the troll is alive. Other models can never fire this catapult as Untrained Crew. The catapult cannot be destroyed as normal if an enemy spends an entire turn in base contact.
catapult.name: Catapult

goblin-crew.description: If the troll wins a Combat, then after making Strikes, the Goblins may make D6 additional strikes with Strength 3. If the troll uses a Brutal Power Attack that ends the Combat, then the Goblins will not get these additional Strikes.
goblin-crew.name: Goblin Crew

metal-gauntlets.description: Any Strikes made by the model are resolved as Strength 10. Also, this model may re-roll the dice when determining the Hurl Distance when using Hurl Brutal Power Attack.
metal-gauntlets.name: Metal Gauntlets

relentless-advance.description: Ogres can pass through friendly Orc, Goblin and Bat models when they Charge into Combat, but not when forced to Move from Magical Powers or special rules. Each model they pass through suffers a Strength 3 hit. Any model that the Ogre ends their move on is automatically slain.
relentless-advance.name: Relentless Advance

crushing-club.description: Any strikes made with this weapon count as having the Mighty Blow special rule. Also, any model struck by this weapon and not slain must roll a D6 at the end of the Combat. On a 3+, that model is immediately knocked Prone.
crushing-club.name: Crushing Club

scythe-gauntlets.description: A Gundabad Troll armed with Scythe Gauntlets increases its Attacks to 4.
scythe-gauntlets.name: Scythe Gauntlets

end-the-race-of-man.description: Whilst Engaged in Combat with an enemy Man model, Guritz gains a +1 bonus to his Fight value.
end-the-race-of-man.name: End the Race of Man

master-of-reserves.description: "In Scenarios where you roll for Warbands to arrive, even if Guritz is not on the battlefield, you may modify the roll for Guritz
master-of-reserves.name: Master of Reserves

the-windlord.description: Only Eagle and Wizard models may benefit from Gwaihir's Stand Fast or benefit from his Heroic Actions.
the-windlord.name: The Windlord

banner-of-arwen-evenstar.description: This is a banner with a range of 6\" rather than 3\", and Halbarad never suffers the -1 penalty to his Duel Rolls for carrying a banner. Additionally, friendly models within 6\" and Line of Sight of the Banner of Arwen Evenstar automatically pass any Courage Tests they are required to take.
banner-of-arwen-evenstar.name: Banner of Arwen Evenstar

one-final-blow.description: When slain in Combat, Haldir can make a Strength 4 Strike against all enemy models he was in Combat with. He may also use Might to increase the To Wound rolls as normal.
one-final-blow.name: One Final Blow

defender-of-edoras.description: Whenever Haleth is outnumbered in Combat, if he wins the Duel roll he may re-roll failed To Wound rolls.
defender-of-edoras.name: Defender of Edoras

fight-to-the-last.description: If Haleth is engaged in combat, Aragorn and friendly Rohan Infantry models within 6\" gain +1 Fight value. This ends immediately if Haleth is slain.
fight-to-the-last.name: Fight to the Last

there-is-always-hope.description: Haleth has Attack 2 whilst he is within 6\" of Aragorn.
there-is-always-hope.name: There is Always Hope

exchange-hand-weapon-for-two-handed-weap.name: Exchange hand weapon for two-handed weapon

doorward-of-meduseld.description: As long as Theoden is alive and on the battlefield, Hama and any Rohan Royal Guard within 6\" of him count as having the Dominant (2) special rule.
doorward-of-meduseld.name: Doorward of Meduseld

the-warrior-poet.description: Hama may spend a Will point at the start of any Fight phase. If he does so, friendly Rohan models within 6\" of him may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1, until the end of that turn.
the-warrior-poet.name: The Warrior Poet

leave-my-flowers-alone.description: At the start of the game after deployments, Hamfast's player places three 25mm Flower Markers anywhere on the board. Models can Move over them but cannot end their move or back away onto them. Objects cannot be placed overlapping them. Friendly Hobbits re-roll failed To Wound rolls for Strikes and shooting whilst within 3\" of a Flower Marker. Hamfast also gains +1 To Wound when making Strikes or shooting an enemy within 3\" of a Flower Marker.
leave-my-flowers-alone.name: Leave my Flowers Alone!

tribal-king.description: If this model is your General, it increases its Attacks characteristic to 3 and gains the General Hunter special rule.
tribal-king.name: Tribal King

whip-of-the-masters.description: Each time a friendly Hero model within 6\" attempts a Heroic Move, March or Shoot, roll a D6. On a 4+, the Hero does not spend the Might Point and the Heroic action is free.
whip-of-the-masters.name: Whip of the Masters

preternatural-agility.description: A Hasharin can never be Trapped while still standing.
preternatural-agility.name: Preternatural Agility

into-the-fray.description: Helm may declare a free Heroic Combat each Fight phase. However, after he has slain an enemy model, he must always Charge an enemy model if possible, for the rest of the battle.
into-the-fray.name: Into the Fray

the-horn-of-the-hammerhand.description: Once per game at start of any Move phase, Helm can blow this horn. Until the end of that turn, enemy models within 24\" of Helm suffer a -1 penalty to Courage tests.

helm-hammerhand-wraith-of-the-hornburg.name: Helm Hammerhand, Wraith of the Hornburg

berserk-rage.description: Helm must always Charge if able to do so. When he Charges, he gains Terror until the end of the turn, and may declare a free Heroic Combat in the Fight phase.

the-horn-of-the-hammerhand.description: Once per game at start of any Move phase, Helm can blow this horn. Until the end of that turn, enemy models within 24\" of Helm suffer a -1 penalty to Courage tests.

daughter-of-rohan.description: If Hera is in a 1-on-1 combat with no supporting models involved, she gains Attack 3 and may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1.

spyglass.description: Hera may ignore the Stalk Unseen special rule of enemy models, and may draw Line of Sight to them as normal.
spyglass.name: Spyglass

fury-of-the-hammerhand.description: When Hera Charges, she must re-roll any failed To Wound rolls in that turn.
fury-of-the-hammerhand.name: Fury of the Hammerhand

the-warrior-bride.description: Enemy models Engaged in Combat with Hera cannot declare a Heroic Strike.
the-warrior-bride.name: The Warrior Bride

pennant-of-the-dead.description: Friendly Dunharrow models within 3\" gain Resistant to Magic.
pennant-of-the-dead.name: Pennant of the Dead

the-kings-counsel.description: If the King of the Dead is within 3\", he may use this model's Will points to declare Heroic Actions, instead of using his own Might points.
the-kings-counsel.name: The King's Counsel

the-heralds-duty.description: This model receives a bonus of +1 to its Defence for each other friendly model with this special rule it is in base contact with. If you have multiple King’s Champions in your Army, they will only get this bonus for being in base contact with models from their own Warband (i.e., a Herald from one King’s Champion cannot provide the bonus to a model from another King’s Champion).
the-heralds-duty.name: The Herald's Duty

the-life-guard.description: If the King’s Champion this Herald belongs to is Wounded, and this model is in base contact with it, this model may expend its Fate Points on behalf of the King’s Champion. Note that they cannot suffer Wounds on the King’s Champion’s behalf – they may only spend their Fate Points.
the-life-guard.name: The Life Guard

stand-by-our-men.description: If Hilda-Bianca Charges into Combat, then during the ensuing Fight phase, she and friendly Lake-town Warrior models within 3\" of her gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.
stand-by-our-men.name: Stand by our Men!

flaming-brand.description: A model with a Flaming Brand has the Terror (Cavalry) and Terror (Beast) special rules. Additionally, this model counts as 2 models rather than 1 when working out how many models are within range of an objective marker.
flaming-brand.name: Flaming Brand

brutish-cunning.description: This model may re-roll a single D6 in a Duel Roll when fighting solely against Infantry models (but not Monster models).
brutish-cunning.name: Brutish Cunning

head-shirriff.description: Holfoot, and any Hobbit Shirriffs (including Robin Smallburrow) within 3\" of him, do not suffer the -1 penalty to their Duel Roll for using their hand-and-a-half weapon as a two-handed weapon.
head-shirriff.name: Head Shirriff

orc-archers.description: The Orcs in the Howdah are not treated as separate models, and as such cannot be targeted individually. During the Shoot Phase, the Howdah can make a number of shooting attacks equal to its remaining Wounds, using its own Shoot Value. These shots are treated as being made with an Orc bow, can still be made if the Great Beast has Moved over half its Move Value, and do not suffer the -1 penalty for Moving and Shooting. Measure the range from the base of the Great Beast, and Line of Sight from the Commander.

in-defence-of-the-king.name: In Defence of the King

lines-of-command.description: Your opponent cannot score Victory Points for Wounding or slaying the enemy General, so long as Hurin is alive on the battlefield and your General has the Gondor keyword.
lines-of-command.name: Lines of Command

resolute-fighter.description: Ingold and friendly Gondor Warrior models within 3\" do not Back Away if they lose a Combat - their opponent must Back Away instead. However, this does not mean that a model benefiting from this rule cannot count as being Trapped, when they lose their Duel roll.
resolute-fighter.name: Resolute Fighter

defend-the-white-city.description: Irolas may use the Shielding special rule, even without a shield. If he wins a Combat whilst Shielding, he may make a single Strike against one enemy model.

acurate.name: Acurate

piercing-shot.description: A model hit will be flung back D6\" if it has a Strength of 5 or lower. Any models passed over are knocked prone and take a Strength 5 hit. The flung model stops if it hits impassable terrain or a model with Strength 6 or higher, and both take a Strength 6 hit. The flung model is knocked prone if it survives. If the flung model would end its movement over other models, those models are moved the minimum distance to allow the flung model to be placed.
piercing-shot.name: Piercing Shot

raise-the-ladders.description: An Isengard Assault Ballista can be used to raise a ladder onto enemy battlements in a siege game. Choose a point on the battlements within range and roll to hit. If successful, place a ladder within 6\" of the wall base below the target point against the battlements. A model that was carrying the ladder can be placed at the top and will count as charging if there is a defender there. If not, the model can move normally.
raise-the-ladders.name: Raise the Ladders!

the-shards-of-narsil.description: If your army also contains Elendil and he is slain, place a 25mm marker where he was killed. If Isildur ends his Activation within 1\" of this marker, he gains the Shards of Narsil. This is a hand weapon for which Isildur gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making strikes in a Combat.
the-shards-of-narsil.name: The Shards of Narsil

heart-of-darkness.description: At the start of the Move Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, Kardush can choose a single friendly Orc Warrior model within 6\" of himself. If he does, the chosen model is removed as a casualty and Kardush immediately regains D3 Will Points spent earlier in the battle.
heart-of-darkness.name: Heart of Darkness

shadow-pawn.description: At the start of the Move Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, Kardush's controlling player can choose to remove him from the battlefield as a casualty if he is within 6\" of a friendly Ringwraith. If they do, then a single friendly Ringwraith model within 6\" of where Kardush was immediately regains D6 Will Points spent earlier in the battle.
shadow-pawn.name: Shadow Pawn

essence-leech.description: Each time Khamul slays an enemy model in Combat, he immediately regains a single Will Point spent earlier in the battle. Additionally, at the start of the Fight Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, Khamul may spend a Will Point to increase either his Fight Value, Strength or Attacks by 1 until the End Phase of the turn. Note this will only ever affect Khamul, not any Mount he is riding.
essence-leech.name: Essence Leech

one-of-nine.description: Maximum of nine Nazgul models in your Army. Hero models wearing the One Ring are not invisible to these models.
one-of-nine.name: One of Nine

unholy-resurrection.description: When slain, place a marker where this model was killed. Models may not overlap these markers for any reason. During the Priority phase of each turn, after Priority has been determined, roll a D6. On a 3+, remove the marker and immediately place this model anywhere within 3\" of the marker, but not in base contact with it. If this is not possible, place the model where the marker was. On a 1-2, the model is slain and the marker is removed. The Necromancer can use his Will points to improve this roll, as long as the Nazgul are in range of the Necromancer's Master of the Nazgul special rule. Whilst the marker is in play, this model counts as being on the board for the purpose of determining if your army is Broken or reduced to 25%. However, a marker cannot hold objectives, and this model still counts as being slain for any special rules that come into effect when a model is slain, such as a Heroic Combat. If this model is slain by a Magical Power or an Elven weapon, they suffer a -1 penalty to their roll. When the game ends, any markers still on the board are removed and the associated models will be counted as casualties.
unholy-resurrection.name: Unholy Resurrection

chariot-charge.description: When a Khandish Charioteer Moves via Chariot Charge, it will inflict 2 Strength 4 Impact Hits.
chariot-charge.name: Chariot Charge

chariot-charge.description: When a Khandish Charioteer Moves via Chariot Charge, it will inflict 2 Strength 4 Impact Hits.
chariot-charge.name: Chariot Charge

commanding-presence.description: Friendly Khand models treat a Khandish King as a banner with a range of 6\".
commanding-presence.name: Commanding Presence

kili-the-dwarf-champion-of-erebor.name: Kili the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

combat-synergy.description: At the start of any phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, if Kili and Fili are within 1\" of each other, then they can swap places and not have it count as Moving. If they do this, then during the Fight phase of that turn they may re-roll a single D6 in the Duel roll.
combat-synergy.name: Combat Synergy

combat-synergy.name: Combat Synergy

kingdoms-of-men.description: A King off Dale's Stand Fast is 12\", and also affects Dale Hero models.
kingdoms-of-men.name: Kingdoms of Men

drain-soul.description: Any model that suffers a Wound from the King of the Dead, that is not prevented by Fate, is immediately killed.
drain-soul.name: Drain Soul

the-dead-and-the-living.description: Only friendly Dunharrow models may benefit from the King of the Dead's Stand Fast or Heroic Actions.
the-dead-and-the-living.name: The Dead and the Living

the-heralds-duty.description: This model receives a bonus of +1 to its Defence for each other friendly model with this special rule it is in base contact with. If you have multiple King’s Champions in your Army, they will only get this bonus for being in base contact with models from their own Warband (i.e., a Herald from one King’s Champion cannot provide the bonus to a model from another King’s Champion).
the-heralds-duty.name: The Herald's Duty

master-archer.description: This model only fails an In The Way Test on the roll of a natural 1. Additionally, if this model slays an enemy Hero or Monster model with a shooting attack, then you may restore this model's Might to its starting value.
master-archer.name: Master Archer

wall-of-blades.description: This model gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes with their spear against a model that Charged them this turn.
wall-of-blades.name: Wall of Blades

exchange-shield-and-lance-for-banner.name: Exchange shield and lance for banner

the-bladelords-skill.description: If this model is Engaged in Combat with an enemy Hero, it may re-roll a single D6 during the Duel Roll.
the-bladelords-skill.name: The Bladelord's Skill

white-sword-of-gondor.description: This is a two-handed weapon. Additionally, Strikes made with a White Sword of Gondor have the Mighty Blow special rule.
white-sword-of-gondor.name: White Sword of Gondor

everyone-has-a-price.description: Whilst within 6\" and Line of Sight of the Master of Lake-town, this model may re-roll failed To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes. This rule has no effect if the Master of Lake-town has no Will points remaining.
everyone-has-a-price.name: Everyone has a Price

everyone-has-a-price.description: Whilst within 6\" and Line of Sight of the Master of Lake-town, this model may re-roll failed To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes. This rule has no effect if the Master of Lake-town has no Will points remaining.
everyone-has-a-price.name: Everyone has a Price

onwards-men-of-esgaroth.description: Lake-town Militia that are within 3\" of a friendly Lake-town Hero model who is Engaged in Combat automatically pass any Courage tests they are required to make for being in a Broken army.
onwards-men-of-esgaroth.name: Onwards Men of Esgaroth

deadly-shot.description: Legolas can make three shooting attacks instead of one during the Shoot Phase, using all the normal rules for shooting. He can still shoot whilst Engaged in Combat, and does not  suffer the -1 penalty To Hit for Moving and Shooting, as long as he has the Infantry keyword. He can also shoot at models he is Engaged in Combat with, requiring no In The Way tests (though they may still block Line of Sight).
deadly-shot.name: Deadly Shot

orcrist.description: Elven hand-and-a-half weapon, with Orcbane, Goblinbane and Uruk-haibane, Terror (Goblin), Terror (Orc) and Terror (Uruk-hai) special rules.
orcrist.name: Orcrist

pinpoint-shot.description: Instead of shooting normally, Legolas can make a single shot against an enemy Engaged in Combat with himself or a friendly model. If the To Hit roll is successful, he doesn’t need to make any In The Way rolls - the shot will automatically hit its target.
pinpoint-shot.name: Pinpoint Shot

final-count-42.description: If Legolas has fewer kills than Gimli, he gains +1 To Wound on shooting attacks.
final-count-42.name: Final Count, 42

pinpoint-shot.description: Instead of shooting normally, Legolas can make a single shot against an enemy Engaged in Combat with himself or a friendly model. If the To Hit roll is successful, he doesn’t need to make any In The Way rolls - the shot will automatically hit its target.
pinpoint-shot.name: Pinpoint Shot

orders-from-edoras.description:
Lief may spend a Will point at the end of his Activation, as long as he is not Engaged in Combat, to pick one of the following orders that last until the end of the turn. Each order can only be chosen once per game.
1. Friendly Rohan Hero models within 3\" can declare a free Heroic Combat.
2. Friendly Rohan models within 3\" gain the Fearless special rule.
3. Friendly Rohan models with 3\" do not suffer the -1 penalty To Hit when moving and shooting, and may re-roll failed To Hit rolls.
4. Friendly Rohan models that start their Activation within 3\" of Lief gain Woodland Creature and Mountain Dweller.
5. Friendly Rohan models that start their Activation within 3\" of Lief increase their Move value by 2\".
orders-from-edoras.name: Orders from Edoras

song-of-elbereth.description: All friendly Rivendell models within 3\" of Lindir gain the Resistant to Magic special rule.
song-of-elbereth.name: Song of Elbereth

wise-council.description: If Lindir is within 6\" of Elrond, then Elrond may spend a single point of Will each turn for free. If he does not use this point by the end of the turn, then it is lost.
wise-council.name: Wise Council

a-stern-scolding.description: Once per turn during her Activation, Lobelia can spend a Will point, and choose an enemy model within 6\" and Line of Sight. Roll a D6, and on a 2+, that model cannot Activate this turn. Also, their Attack is reduced to 1 in any Combat. Does not affect Monster, Chariot or War Beast models.
a-stern-scolding.name: A Stern Scolding

furious-tirade.description: Enemy Warrior models from may not benefit from a Hero model's Stand Fast whilst within 6\" of Lobelia.
furious-tirade.name: Furious Tirade

umbrella.description: If Lobelia wins a Combat, she may not make Strikes.
umbrella.name: Umbrella

edoras-shall-fall.description: During the Fight phase, friendly Rohirrim Traitors within 6\" of Lord Thorne gain a bonus of +1 to their Fight value.
edoras-shall-fall.name: Edoras Shall Fall

traitor-of-rohan.description: Lord Thorne may only include Rohirrim Traitors in his Warband.
traitor-of-rohan.name: Traitor of Rohan

powers-of-nature.description: If this model rolls a natural 6 during its Casting Test, then upon completion of the Magical Power it regains a number of Will Points equal to the number of Will Points spent during the Casting Test.
powers-of-nature.name: Powers of Nature

wood-elf-spear.description: An Elven spear, and this model may use the Shielding rule even if they do not have a shield.
wood-elf-spear.name: Wood Elf spear

considerable-wealth.description:
Lotho may spend his Will Points to pay off models around him in the following ways:
At the start of a Fight Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, Lotho can spend a Will Point to use this ability. If he does, until the End Phase of the turn, friendly Hobbit models within 3" of Lotho gain a +1 bonus to their Fight Value.
At the start of a Move Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, Lotho can spend a Will Point to use this ability. If he does, until the End Phase of the turn, friendly Ruffian models within 3" of Lotho count as having the Fearless special rule.
When an enemy model attempts to Charge Lotho, Lotho may spend a Will Point to use this ability. If he does, roll a D6. On a 2+, the enemy model stops 1" away from Lotho instead of Charging him and their Activation immediately ends.
considerable-wealth.name: Considerable Wealth

family-rivalry.description: Lotho may not take part in any Heroic Actions declared by either Bilbo Baggins or Frodo Baggins.
family-rivalry.name: Family Rivalry

find-the-halflings.description: Lurtz may choose the result of the Maelstrom of Battle special rule for his warband, rather than rolling.
find-the-halflings.name: Find the Halflings

oblivious-to-pain.description: Whenever Lurtz suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On a natural 6, the Wound is ignored.
oblivious-to-pain.name: Oblivious to Pain

shield-throw.description: If Lurtz has a shield, he may use it as throwing weapon once per game with a Strength of 4. Any 25mm model hit will be knocked prone, and he may re-roll the To Hit roll. Once thrown, Lurtz will no longer carry the shield.
shield-throw.name: Shield Throw

birdcalls.description: Mablung and any Rangers of Gondor (including Faramir, Madril, Damrod and Anborn) within 6\" of him gain the Stalk Unseen special rule. Additionally, Mablung and any Rangers of Gondor (including Faramir, Madril, Damrod and Anborn) within 6\" of him ignore the Stalk Unseen special rule of enemy models.
birdcalls.name: Birdcalls

master-of-reserves.description: In Scenarios where you roll for Warbands to arrive, even if Madril is not on the battlefield, you may modify the roll for Madril's Warband by +1 or -1. If he is already on the battlefield, you may modify the roll for other Warbands in your army.
master-of-reserves.name: Master of Reserves

mahud-beastmaster-chieftain.description: The Haradrim Commander is replaced by a Mahud Beastmaster Chieftain, which is placed on the forked wooden platform at the front of the Howdah.
mahud-beastmaster-chieftain.name: Mahud Beastmaster Chieftain

foresight-of-the-eldar.description: At the start of the game, before either side deploys, roll a D6 and make a note of the result - this is the number of Foresight Points that Malbeth has for the battle. During the roll for Priority, so long as he is alive and on the battlefield, Malbeth can spend these Foresight Points to increase the roll on his controlling player's roll for Priority. For each Foresight Point spent, increase the dice roll by 1, to a maximum of 6.
foresight-of-the-eldar.name: Foresight of the Eldar

gift-of-foresight.description: Every time a friendly Arnor model suffers a Wound within 6\" and Line of Sight of Malbeth, roll a D6. On a 5+, the Wound is prevented. If failed, Hero models may still use Fate points as normal.
gift-of-foresight.name: Gift of Foresight

pride-of-dol-amroth.description: Whilst within 3\" of Prince Imrahil, this model gains a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value.
pride-of-dol-amroth.name: Pride of Dol Amroth

durins-protector.description: During the Declare Heroic Actions step of the Fight phase, if Durin is Engaged in Combat within 6\" of Mardin, then Mardin may declare a free Heroic Combat. If this is successful, Mardin must use the following Move to join Durin's Combat if able, or move as close as possible to him. Mardin cannot use this special rule if he is in the same Combat as Durin.
durins-protector.name: Durin's Protector

torozul.description: This is a Foe Spear, with the Trollbane special rule. Additionally, Mardin adds +1 when rolling To Wound against Monster models.
torozul.name: Torozul

unhinged-charge.description: At the start of a Combat in which Mauhur Charged, Mauhur may declare he is using this special rule before any dice are rolled. If he does, then he suffers a -1 penalty to his Duel Rolls; however, if his side wins, he may re-roll any failed To Wound rolls when making Strikes in that Combat.
unhinged-charge.name: Unhinged Charge

additional-text.text-1: Any Hobbit Militia in Merry's Warband upgraded to Battlin Brandybucks have Strength 3.

meriadoc-brandybuck-captain-of-the-shire.name: Meriadoc Brandybuck, Captain of the Shire

horn-of-the-riddermark.description: A war horn. Additionally, Merry gains the Fearless special rule.
horn-of-the-riddermark.name: Horn of the Riddermark

for-the-shire.description: If Merry is within 3\" of Boromir of Gondor, Merry may spend his Might points as if they were his own.
for-the-shire.name: For the Shire!

elven-glaive.description: Elven spear, when Engaged in Combat and not being Supported, this model may either gain a bonus of +1 Attack for the Duel roll or +1 Attack when making Strikes. This must be decided before the Duel roll takes place.
elven-glaive.name: Elven Glaive

kings-knights.description: Whilst they have the Cavalry keyword, this model gains a bonus of +1 Fight and +1 Defence whilst within 6\" of Thranduil.
kings-knights.name: King's Knights

elven-glaive.description: Elven spear, when Engaged in Combat and not being Supported, this model may either gain a bonus of +1 Attack for the Duel roll or +1 Attack when making Strikes. This must be decided before the Duel roll takes place.
elven-glaive.name: Elven Glaive

spider-webs.description: A Mirkwood Spider can shoot webs, treated as a throwing weapon with a range of 8\". If the spider hits its target, do not roll To Wound. Instead, the model suffers the effects of the Paralyse Magical Power, however the effects will not immediately end should this model have no Will points or be slain. If this hits a Cavalry model, both the rider and mount will be hit. A Hero model hit may spend a Fate point to avoid its effects If the Hero is a Cavalry model, this would negate the effects on both the rider and mount.
spider-webs.name: Spider Webs

silent-hunters.description: If a Mirkwood Hunting Spider is within a piece of woodland terrain, such as a forest, or is partially concealed by a piece of woodland terrain, then they cannot be seen by enemy models unless they are within 6\" of the Mirkwood Hunting Spider.
silent-hunters.name: Silent Hunters

knife-fighters.description: If Outnumbered in Combat, then before making their Duel roll, this model gains +1 Attack for each model they are Engaged in Combat with, after the first, up to the a maximum of 3 bonus Attacks. This bonus lasts until the end of the Combat.
knife-fighters.name: Knife Fighters

knife-fighters.description: If Outnumbered in Combat, then before making their Duel roll, this model gains +1 Attack for each model they are Engaged in Combat with, after the first, up to the a maximum of 3 bonus Attacks. This bonus lasts until the end of the Combat.
knife-fighters.name: Knife Fighters

end-the-race-of-man.description: Whilst Engaged in Combat with an enemy Man model, this model gains a +1 bonus to his Fight value.
end-the-race-of-man.name: End the Race of Man

end-the-race-of-man.description: Whilst Engaged in Combat with an enemy Man model, this model gains a +1 bonus to his Fight value.
end-the-race-of-man.name: End the Race of Man

plenty-of-orcs.description: If the Orc Commander would lose its last Wound whilst riding the Great Beast, then the Howdah will suffer the Wound instead (this represents an Orc from the Howdah taking command). If the Great Beast is slain, then the Orc Commander will also be slain and removed as a casualty.
plenty-of-orcs.name: Plenty of Orcs

whip-of-the-masters.description: Each time a friendly Hero model within 6\" attempts a Heroic Move, Heroic March or Heroic Shoot, roll a D6. On a 4+, that action is free for that Hero.
whip-of-the-masters.name: Whip of the Masters

additional-text.text-1: Crewed by three Mordor Orc Siege Crew, one of which is the Siege Veteran.

accurate.description: A Mordor Siege Bow will only Scatter 3\" rather than 6\".
accurate.name: Accurate

piercing-shot.description: A model hit will be flung back D6\" if it has a Strength of 5 or lower. Any models passed over are knocked prone and take a Strength 5 hit. The flung model stops if it hits impassable terrain or a model with Strength 6 or higher, and both take a Strength 6 hit. The flung model is knocked prone if it survives. If the flung model would end its  movement over other models, those models are moved the minimum distance to allow the flung model to be placed.
piercing-shot.name: Piercing Shot

cleaving-blow.description: If this model rolls a natural 6 To Wound, and the Wound is successful, the target suffers 2 Wounds rather than 1.
cleaving-blow.name: Cleaving Blow

cleaving-blow.description: If this model rolls a natural 6 To Wound, and the Wound is successful, the target suffers 2 Wounds rather than 1.
cleaving-blow.name: Cleaving Blow

additional-text.text-1: Crewed by three Mordor Orc Siege Crew, one of which is the Siege Veteran, and a Mordor Siege Troll.

area-effect.description: After rolling To Hit against a Battlefield Target, all other models within 2\" of them suffer a Strength 5 and will be knocked Prone.
area-effect.name: Area Effect

troll-loader.description: May re-roll the To Hit roll if the Siege Troll is one of the models firing the catapult this turn.
troll-loader.name: Troll Loader

wall-breaker.description: When rolling To Wound against a Siege Target, make two To Wound rolls and pick the highest. Also, a successful To Wound roll against a Siege Target will do D3 Wounds rather than 1.
wall-breaker.name: Wall-breaker

run-and-drum.description: The Drum is considered to be playing as long as both the Drummer and Drum Bearer are in base contact, and the Drummer is not Engaged in Combat. Whilst the Drum is being played it has the following effects: • Friendly Moria Goblin models gain a bonus of +1 to any Courage Tests they are required to take. • Enemy models suffer a -1 penalty to any Courage Tests they are required to take. • Friendly Moria Goblin models within 18\" count as being in range of a banner. • Whilst being played, the Moria Blackshield Drum counts as a banner for the purpose of Victory Points.
run-and-drum.name: Run and Drum

take-up-the-drum.description: If the Moria Blackshield Drummer or Moria Blackshield Drum Bearer is slain, then they may pass on their wargear to a friendly Moria Blackshield Warrior within 1\" of them. The chosen model becomes a Moria Blackshield Drummer/Drum Bearer (as applicable) and exchanges their wargear for that of the slain model - replace the chosen model with the slain Moria Blackshield Drummer/Drum Bearer.
take-up-the-drum.name: Take up the Drum

drums-in-the-deep.description:
For the Drum to be played, at least one Drummer must be in base contact with it, have not Moved that turn, and not be Engaged in Combat. Whilst the Drum is being played it has the following effects:

* Friendly Moria Goblin models gain a bonus of +1 to any Courage Tests they are required to take.
* Enemy models suffer a -1 penalty to any Courage Tests they are required to take.
* Friendly Moria Goblin models within 18" count as being in range of a banner.
* Whilst being played, the Moria Goblin Drum counts as a banner for the purpose of Victory Points.
drums-in-the-deep.name: Drums in the Deep

moria-goblin-drum.description: The Drum has 10 Defence, 3 Wounds, is a Heavy Object, can be shot at, is always on a 25mm base and must be deployed in base contact with one of its Moria Goblin Drummers. If, during the End Phase, an enemy model is in base contact with the Drum, and the only thing that model has done is Move this turn (e.g. no shooting, combat etc.), and that model was not affected by a Magical Power this turn, then it can remove the Drum from play.
moria-goblin-drum.name: Moria Goblin Drum

take-up-the-drum.description: If a Drummer is slain, then they may pass on their wargear to a friendly Moria Goblin Warrior within 1\" of them. The chosen model becomes a Moria Goblin Drummer and exchanges their wargear for that of the slain model - replace the chosen model with the slain Moria Goblin Drummer.
take-up-the-drum.name: Take up the Drum

sense-of-impending-doom.description: Enemy models within 6\" of the Mouth of Sauron cannot re-roll 1s in the Duel Roll, regardless of special rules that would normally allow them to do so.
sense-of-impending-doom.name: Sense of Impending Doom

high-king-of-the-south.description: The Mumak War Leader's Stand Fast is 12\", and his warband may deploy within 12\" of him rather than 6\", and may be deployed outside of the Howdah. Measure the 12\" range from the base of the Mumak.
high-king-of-the-south.name: High King of the South

imposing-presence.description: Whilst mounted on the Royal War Mumak, the first time each turn an enemy model declares a Heroic move within 12\", roll a D6. On a 4+, the action is cancelled and the Might point is lost. Measure the 12\" range from the base of the Mumak.
imposing-presence.name: Imposing Presence

long-bladed-spear.description: Can be a spear or a two-handed weapon.
long-bladed-spear.name: Long-bladed Spear

kalazal.description: This is a Unique hand weapon. Murin gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes against Orc, Goblin or Uruk-hai models.
kalazal.name: Kalazal

power-from-death.description: Whenever Muzgur slays an enemy model in Combat, he immediately regains a Will Point spent earlier in the battle.
power-from-death.name: Power from Death

lethal-aim.description: Each Turn, Narzug gains a free Might point that can only be spent during a shooting attack on either the To Hit, To Wound or In The Way roll. If this point is not spent by the end of the turn, it is lost.
lethal-aim.name: Lethal Aim

scavenge.description: Whenever Nazthak slays an enemy model in Combat (with the exception of Monster models), he may choose to scavenge a single piece of wargear carried by that model, with the exception of a Mount, another type of armour, living creatures, the One Ring, or items of wargear that are integral to the model (such as claws and teeth). This will happen before any effects that allow the slain model to pass on that piece of wargear. Add the scavenged item to Nazthak's list of wargear. Nazthak will benefit from the scavenged wargear as if he was the original model. Nazthak may choose to discard any piece of scavenged wargear at any time, though if he does so then he cannot reclaim it - it is lost.
scavenge.name: Scavenge

wood-elf-spear.description: An Elven spear, and this model may use the Shielding rule even if they do not have a shield.
wood-elf-spear.name: Wood Elf spear

just-a-couple-of-keepsakes.description: When Nori is carrying an Objective in Scenarios, he may re-roll all failed To Wound rolls when making Strikes. However, he may never pass the Objective to a friendly model.

healing-herbs.description: At any point during his Activation, Oin can choose a friendly Thorin's Company model in base contact and roll a D6. On a 4+, they regain a lost Wound. Can only be used once per turn.
healing-herbs.name: Healing Herbs

hearing-trumpet.description: When an enemy Hero declares a Heroic Action within 6\" of Oin, roll a D6. On a 5+, Oin can declare it for free. However, on a natural 1, he loses a Will point. If he already has no Will points left, then he cannot Move during that turn.
hearing-trumpet.name: Hearing Trumpet

reading-the-portents.description: During the Fight phase, Oin can spend a Will point to enable a friendly model within 6\" to re-roll one dice in their Duel roll. This may be used multiple times in the same Fight Phase.
